import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
from xml.etree import ElementTree

root = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-subcontract-intake')
source = root / 'agency-discovery-rss.xml'
payload = source.read_bytes()
expected = '1e609f03ba6a4c0dbe3403eb301a82169d3cc7d07a70e4389d99ba22323196ba'
actual = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
if actual != expected:
    raise SystemExit('Saved feed differs from TASK-179515080101')
items = []
for entry in ElementTree.fromstring(payload).findall('./channel/item'):
    url = (entry.findtext('link') or '').strip()
    parsed = urlsplit(url)
    items.append({'title': (entry.findtext('title') or '').strip(), 'url': url, 'host': parsed.hostname, 'snippet': (entry.findtext('description') or '').strip()[:600]})
result = {'source_receipt': 'TASK-179515080101', 'source_sha256': actual, 'item_count': len(items), 'items': items, 'scope': 'Discovery leads only. Original pages must establish paid work, scope, eligibility and a permitted response route. Check prior prospects before using either original-page slot.'}
output = root / 'agency-leads.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
